checkpoints.description: [1/4] Add an end-to-end Phase 2 lead-selection run: curate -> screen -> consensus rank, a hashed run manifest, and a Markdown lead report.

impact_assessment.why: The three Phase 2 commands work in isolation but nothing produces the Phase 2 deliverable as one reproducible, auditable run with provenance and evidence gaps.
impact_assessment.benefits: One command turns vendor CSVs and docking exports into a traceable lead set, and the manifest hashes make every artifact checkable after the fact.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new manifest and report schemas plus a new CLI; dependency: none, standard library only; concurrency: outputs are atomic and each run owns its out-dir; state: no persisted state beyond generated artifacts.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Freeze the schemas in docs and a new ADR, hash every input and output, keep the three stages as the existing tested functions, and cover chain, empty-stage, report and manifest paths with tests.

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Verification: 75 tests pass; Phase 4 gates 4/4 (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); pipeline CLI and report complete; checklists: passed; uncommitted pending authorization
Task 'pnn-phase2-pipeline' completed successfully.
[1/6] Target profile invariants and binding-pocket validator (pnn/target.py, CLI python -m pnn.target)

impact_assessment.why: PNN currently has in silico screening, curation, and docking consensus tools, but lacks target binding-pocket validation, realistic reference datasets for golden runs, and an executable Phase 3 in vitro assay ingestion pipeline to qualify leads into confirmed experimental hits.
impact_assessment.benefits: Verifiable target receptor profiles and grid coordinates prevent docking against incorrect pockets; realistic reference datasets enable turnkey golden-run validation; Phase 3 assay pipeline evaluates fluorogenic DQ-CS cleavage, PAMPA-BBB/MDCK-MDR1 permeability, and cytotoxicity counter-screens against explicit criteria.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new schemas for assay CSVs and target definitions; dependency: none, Python standard library only; concurrency: atomic temp+fsync+replace for all generated outputs; state: no persistent state beyond generated CSV/JSON artifacts.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Strict validation of CSV contracts with clear remediation triads, comprehensive test suites covering edge cases and malformed rows, and recording ADR-005 in project memory.

checkpoints.description: [6/6] Verification: 91 tests pass; 4/4 gates pass (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); target, golden run and assay pipeline verified; checklists: passed; uncommitted pending authorization
Task 'pnn-validation-suite-v1' completed successfully.
[1/6] In vivo PK/PD non-compartmental analysis and candidate selection engine (pnn/preclinical.py, CLI python -m pnn.preclinical)

impact_assessment.why: PNN has progressed through in silico triage and in vitro assay qualification, but lacks in vivo pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) candidate selection, SAR scaffold decomposition, and interactive visualization reporting for end-to-end decision making.
impact_assessment.benefits: Rigorous NCA PK analysis (Cmax, AUC, t1/2, F, Kp,brain) and in vivo PD (WFA+ reduction, ITT AUC) enables objective preclinical candidate advancement; SAR scaffold clustering guides chemical lead optimization; standalone HTML visualization studio provides intuitive graphical oversight without external dependencies.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new preclinical CSV contracts and HTML output formats; dependency: none, Python standard library only; concurrency: atomic temporary file generation; state: no persistent state beyond generated CSV, JSON, and HTML reports.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Strict validation with remediation triads, unit tests covering mathematical edge cases, and registering ADR-006.

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Verification: 118 tests pass; 4/4 gates pass (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); preclinical, studio, and SAR pipelines verified; checklists: passed
Task 'pnn-preclinical-studio-sar-v1' completed successfully.
[1/4] Add one-click turnkey discovery runner (pnn/runner.py, run.py, start.bat, start.sh) and Phase 5 multiparametric optimization engine (pnn/mpo.py)

impact_assessment.why: PNN has modular CLI pipelines for in silico triage, docking, in vitro assays, preclinical PK/PD, and SAR, but lacks a turnkey one-click launcher for rapid execution and visualization, and lacks a unified Phase 5 Multiparametric Optimization (MPO) desirability scoring engine for candidate selection.
impact_assessment.benefits: One-click start enables instant execution of the full discovery pipeline and launches the interactive dashboard in <1s; Phase 5 CNS MPO and Derringer-Suich composite desirability index systematically ranks clinical candidates across potency, BBB penetration, oral F, and safety margins.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new runner and MPO CLI options and output schemas; dependency: none, Python standard library only; concurrency: atomic output writers; state: no persistent state outside generated reports.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Thorough unit and CLI tests, error remediation triads, and registering ADR-007.

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Verification: 129 tests pass; 4/4 gates pass (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); one-click launcher and Phase 5 MPO engine verified; checklists: passed
Task 'pnn-one-click-and-mpo-v1' completed successfully.
[1/3] Configure one-click start to launch browser UI automatically by default

impact_assessment.why: One-click start (start.bat, start.sh, python run.py) previously required an explicit --open flag and start.bat was passing --no-browser, preventing the interactive visual studio dashboard from opening automatically upon launch.
impact_assessment.benefits: Double-clicking start.bat or executing python run.py now automatically launches the interactive studio dashboard in the default system web browser without manual flags.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: default CLI behavior opens browser unless --no-browser is provided; dependency: none, Python standard library webbrowser module; concurrency: none; state: no persistent state.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Preserve --no-browser flag for headless CI and automated unit testing.

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Verification: 130 tests pass; 4/4 gates pass; one-click start launches browser UI automatically by default; checklists: passed
Task 'pnn-browser-ui-auto-open' completed successfully.
[1/6] Implement Hypothalamic Circuit & Dosing Dynamics Simulator (pnn/pathway.py)

impact_assessment.why: PNN requires complete translational capabilities: dosing dynamics to prevent synaptic plasticity side-effects, allometric human clinical dose projection for IND filing, automated bioisosteric optimization of leads, and molecular dynamics trajectory stability analysis.
impact_assessment.benefits: Enables intermittent pulsatile dosing regimens via systems pharmacology ODEs; computes human clinical starting dose and therapeutic index; generates metabolically shielded bioisosteric analogs; validates kinetic stability of docking poses via MD metrics.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new simulation, IND, bioisostere, and trajectory schemas; dependency: none, Python standard library only; concurrency: atomic output writers; state: no persistent state beyond generated CSV, JSON, and Markdown reports.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit test coverage for mathematical ODEs, allometric scaling, SMILES transformations, and trajectory parsers; register ADR-008.
